trigger: A patient or authorized provider initiates a diagnostic testing request.
steps: Identify the requested test or test package.
Determine whether an order or referral is required.
Confirm applicable eligibility and specimen requirements.
Determine collection location or supported home collection.
Select a verified available slot or submit a request.
Provide confirmed status and approved preparation instructions.
decisions: Is the test available at the chosen location?
safety_rules: Do not invent test preparation instructions.
Do not invent diagnostic indications or clinical eligibility.
Do not imply results are available unless a connected system confirms them.
validation_questions: What preparation information is approved for publication?
